summary: KRAFTON offers its Raon-1 mini preview model (30B-A4B) through an API that is free for a limited time to celebrate the model's release. Per-user limits on token usage and the number of requests may apply, and any future charges will be announced separately. No end date is given.
claim_steps: Apply on the Raon page with your name, email, affiliation, role and intended use.
KRAFTON emails you an invitation to the Raon console right away.
Open the invitation, verify your email and set a password; then issue an API key, try the Playground and read the API docs.
